title: Network Approach to Understanding Emotion Dynamics in Relation to Childhood Trauma and Genetic Liability to Psychopathology: Replication of a Prospective Experience Sampling Analysis
limitations: - Limited set of momentary emotional states to overcome convergence problems; - Negative emotion items were subject to floor effects; - Participants were young students living with parents, limiting generalizability; - Differences in means and variances between high CT group and other groups may have affected network comparability.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are available. The authors mention using permutation testing for statistical significance, but do not provide details on code availability. Data availability is not mentioned in the main text or supplementary materials. The study was not preregistered.
